integrity: The analytic reduction is accompanied by an exact symbolic resultant and exact Sturm root counts. Numerical values are only evaluations of the root-defined exact statement.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the classical rectangular constant of the real two-dimensional l_3 space; the exact value is root-defined rather than expressed by radicals, and no assertion is made for arbitrary exponents.
title: Exact rectangular constant of the real \(\ell_3^2\) plane
